title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: The Information Security Team must provide personnel to serve as active members of the acquisition team throughout the entire acquisition process.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: The Information Security Team must detect and evaluate information security risk, develop remediation plans with affected parties, and work with the acquisitions team to implement solutions for identified security risks before connectivity to <Company Name>'s networks is allowed.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: All endpoints, including servers, desktops, and laptops, must be replaced or re-imaged with the <Company Name> standard security baseline configuration and maintain these minimum standards.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: Business-critical production servers that cannot be replaced or re-imaged must be audited.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: An exception for business-critical production servers that cannot be replaced or re-imaged must be granted and documented by the Information Security Team.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: All endpoint computing devices must have <Company Name>-approved antivirus protection and/or Endpoint Detection and Response software (EDR) before a network connection is established.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: All network devices must be replaced or re-imaged with a <Company Name> standard baseline configuration.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: Wireless network access points must be configured to the <Company Name> standard baseline configuration.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: The acquired company’s network must comply with the <Company Name> network standard security baseline configuration.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: All Internet connections must be terminated.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: When justified by business requirements, air-gapped Internet connections must be reviewed and approved by the Information Security Team.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: All remote access connections must be terminated.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: Remote access to any production, test, development, or guest network must be provided by <Company Name>.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: Lab equipment must be physically separated and secured from non-lab areas.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: The lab network must be separated from the corporate production network using a virtual network (VLAN) with a firewall between the two networks.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: Any direct network connections, including analog lines, ISDN lines, and T1 connections, to external customers, partners, or other parties must be reviewed and approved by the Information Security Team or the Lab Security Group (LabSec).

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: All acquired lab networks must conform to the LabSec standard security baseline configuration.

title: Acquisition Assessment Standard
definition: If acquired networks and computer systems fail to meet these requirements, the <Company Name> Chief Risk Officer (CRO) must acknowledge and approve the risk to <Company Name>'s networks.
